## Standing operator rules
- Treat any field ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` as restricted and copy only through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.
- Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in `requirements/license-tools.txt` rather than using `>=` or a floating latest version.
- Run “Elasticsearch Reindex Alias Swap” one step at a time, in the specified order.
- Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
- Active schema is `billing_v3`; `billing_v1` is frozen for finance and must never be seeded or written to.

## Current objective
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` so paid customers are not sent dunning reminders.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Retrying webhook handlers five times duplicated customer emails.
- Retrying all `HTTPStatusError` responses duplicated 4xx delivery attempts; only transport and retryable server errors should retry.

## Plan and progress
- Reindex steps 1–5 done; steps 6–8 pending. Exact step 6 command unavailable.
- Dunning investigation, fix, and tests pending; next command unknown.

## Recent work
Search rebuilding was optimized with tenant scoping, eight-way concurrency, and chunks of 100; 5,000 documents completed in 1.19s. Combined search tests: 33 passed. Shared embedder injection was added to the management command.
